ledger.claim: The driver's own GPS trace never brings him within 780 metres of the pickup pin on this trip: the minimum separation recorded across all 98 driver fixes is 779.93 m. POL-NS-01 makes the fee chargeable ONLY IF limb (b) holds, that is, only if the trace places the driver inside the pickup geofence at or before the 'arrived' event. It plainly does not, so limb (b) fails and the $4.00 cancellation fee is not chargeable at all.

The arrival radius for this STANDARD zone pickup is 50 m under POL-NS-02, and the trace contains zero qualifying in-radius fixes for the driver (qualifying_fix_count 0 across 98 driver fixes) at any point in the 15 minutes preceding the 08:09:40 cancellation. Under POL-NS-02 the driver is therefore deemed never to have arrived, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee.

POL-NS-03 cannot be used to rescue this fee. That clause governs a driver who was stationary outside the arrival radius but within the 400 m wrong-entrance ceiling. Here the driver was never closer than 779.93 m from the pin at any moment of the trip, so he was outside the ceiling throughout, this is not a wrong-entrance or wrong-block case, and no POL-NS-03(ii) pin-ambiguity goodwill payment arises.

The 'arrived' marker on this trip is a false arrival marker under POL-NS-05. It is timed at 2026-07-23T08:02:14+08:00, a moment at which the trace places the driver at least 780 m from the pickup pin (the minimum separation for the whole trace is 779.93 m), far beyond the 300 m threshold that clause sets. The marker is FALSE and does not start the waiting clock.

On the POL-NS-05 recomputed basis the fee must be refunded in full. The waiting clock restarts from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, and there is no qualifying in-geofence fix anywhere in the trip, so under POL-NS-05(ii) the $4.00 fee is refunded in full, no driver compensation is payable, and the trip is to be recorded as a false-arrival event against the driver in the ruling's referrals list.

Independently, the waiting-period shortfall route under POL-NS-06 gives the same result. The effective in-geofence dwell for this STANDARD zone pickup is 0 seconds against a 300 second minimum - a shortfall of 300 seconds - so the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages.

The accumulation limb POL-NS-06(i) is unavailable to the driver here. EV-ADVIS-00201-01 is MISSING - admissibility status MISSING, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight_multiplier 0.0 - so there is no present and populated traffic_advisory that could permit separate in-geofence intervals to be summed, and on the derived facts there are zero in-geofence intervals to sum in any event. I cite the absent artifact for its absence alone.

POL-NS-04 exonerates the rider outright on all three limbs. (a) The rider sent a locating and coordinating message at 08:05:33 - 'hello? i dont see any car at 118' - which both names the block and states that he cannot see the vehicle. (b) The driver posted no reply at all and placed no in-app voice call (trip_record.in_app_calls is empty), so no reply came inside 120 seconds or at any time before termination. (c) The rider track places the rider's device within the STANDARD 100 m presence radius for the majority of qualifying fixes - in fact for all 122 of them, with a maximum deviation of 24.9 m. The rider is exonerated and the fee refunded in full, with no driver compensation payable.

No driver compensation is payable under POL-NS-07. That clause operates only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it. Limb (b) of POL-NS-01 fails on the driver's own trace and POL-NS-04, POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06 each independently displace the fee, so the 80 percent payout of SGD 3.20 of the SGD 4.00 fee does not arise.

The outcome here is party-relative and the record fixes it. This dispute was filed by the rider, and the fare_breakdown shows payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.0 and a 4.00 cancellation-fee line. NO_ACTION would therefore leave the rider carrying the disputed charge, which the evidence does not support; the correct ruling is FULL_REFUND of the cancellation-fee line only, not of any booking or platform fee that would have been charged on a completed trip.

This case does not need to be escalated, and the rider should not be left with the fee merely held. The POL-NS-09 triggers are absent: rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and nothing in the bundle is impaired under the POL-NS-08 limbs - the trace has 100 percent coverage, no gaps and a 10 second cadence, and the chat log's 2 messages match trip_record.chat_message_count. The apparent tension between the trip record's 'arrived' marker and the trace is exactly what POL-NS-05 exists to resolve, so it is not an unresolved conflict requiring human review.

The trip record carries the two things POL-NS-01 asks of the driver personally: a driver 'arrived' event for this trip at 08:02:14, and a termination by the driver at 08:09:40 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW rather than DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE. Limbs (a) and (d) are therefore met on the face of the record, and the driver used one of the three truthful codes the clause recognises.

I cannot carry limbs (b) and (c) of POL-NS-01 on this trace, and I do not ask the Judge to find otherwise. The driver's own 98-fix GPS track never comes closer than 779.9 m to the pickup pin, records zero qualifying in-geofence fixes at the STANDARD arrival radius of 50 m, and shows a longest qualifying in-geofence run of 0.0 seconds against the 300 second minimum dwell. The arrival and dwell limbs of the anchor clause fail on the driver's own telemetry, so the cancellation fee is not chargeable under POL-NS-01 and I do not contend that it stands.

The driver's profile does not support a fee-farming finding, and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming guard does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 3, below the absolute limb of 4, and 3 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 96 is 3.1 percent, below the 0.08 rate limb. The clause requires BOTH limbs and neither is met, so POL-NS-09(d) is not engaged against this driver and this record should not be read as a pattern of harvested no-show fees.

ruling.explanation:
This decides the $4.00 no-show cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-00201. The fee is refunded to the rider in full, and no driver compensation is payable.

TO THE RIDER: your account is supported. The driver's own GPS telemetry (EV-GPS-00201, weight 1.0, 100% coverage, no gaps, 10-second cadence, no clock-skew or trace defect) never brings him closer than 779.93 m to the Blk 118 Rivervale Drive pin, across all 98 driver fixes, and records zero fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius. Your own device sits on the pin throughout (122 fixes, maximum 24.9 m from the pin). POL-NS-01 charges the fee only if all four of its conditions hold, and two fail: limb (b) is not met (the trace does not place the driver in the geofence at or before the 'arrived' event), and limb (c) is not met (zero seconds of in-geofence dwell against the 300-second STANDARD minimum). POL-NS-02 therefore deems the driver never to have arrived, and three further clauses point the same way: POL-NS-04 (you sent a locating message at 08:05:33 saying you could see no car at 118; the driver neither replied within 120 seconds nor placed any in-app call; your device was inside the 100 m presence radius for all 122 fixes), POL-NS-05(ii) (the 'arrived' marker is false), and POL-NS-06 (a 300-second dwell shortfall against a 300-second minimum). Each independently gives a full refund with no driver compensation. We refund the $4.00 cancellation-fee line only; nothing else was charged on this trip.

TO THE DRIVER: we accept the two points you made. Limbs (a) and (d) of POL-NS-01 are indeed met on the face of the trip record — there is an 'arrived' event at 08:02:14 and a driver termination at 08:09:40 under a recognised reason code — but the clause is conjunctive and limbs (b) and (c) fail on your own telemetry, which you properly conceded. We also accept that the POL-NS-07 anti-farming guard does not trip (3 no-show terminations in 30 days, below the absolute limb of 4, and 3.1% of 96 completed trips, below the 0.08 rate limb), so no pattern of harvested fees is found against you. Because POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full and POL-NS-04, POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06 displace the fee, the 80% payout of SGD 3.20 does not arise and driver_compensation_sgd is null. This is not a wrong-entrance case: POL-NS-03 requires the driver to have held position within 400 m of the pin, and you were never closer than 779.93 m, so that route (and any pin-ambiguity goodwill) cannot apply.

The 'arrived' marker at 08:02:14 is a false arrival marker under POL-NS-05: at that timestamp you were far beyond the 300 m threshold. Your waiting clock therefore restarts from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, and there is none anywhere in the trip, which under POL-NS-05(ii) refunds the fee in full and requires the trip to be recorded as a false-arrival event against you. That recording is carried in the referrals list above.

On the absent traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-00201-01, MISSING, weight 0.0): it was cited only for its absence, and we accept that. A missing advisory makes the POL-NS-06(i) accumulation limb unavailable, so no separate in-geofence intervals could be summed on your behalf — and in any event there were zero such intervals to sum.

No escalation applies. POL-NS-09(c) and (d) are not engaged (no counterparty disputes, no qualifying abuse counters), confidence is above the 0.70 floor, and the apparent tension between the record's 'arrived' marker and the GPS track is precisely the conflict POL-NS-05 exists to resolve, so it is not an unresolved contradiction under POL-NS-09(b). PIP: profiles were used only where a clause names the field; nothing was decided on reputation.
referrals: POL-NS-05(ii): record a false-arrival event against driver DRV-01590 for trip TRP-00201 — the driver's 08:02:14 'arrived' marker was placed while his own GPS track put him 779.9 m from the pickup pin (300 m threshold), and the trip contains no qualifying in-geofence fix anywhere.
ruling.referrals_note: referrals carry the POL-NS-05(ii) false-arrival instruction only; no other clause produces one.
